description: Point a booking product at its rule set AND the resources that serve it — both in one call, because a product with only one of them takes no bookings at all. `resourceIds` REPLACES the current list rather than adding to it, so pass every resource that should serve the product. The product must already exist and be of the booking type (create_product with productType "booking").

resourceIds.description: Every resource that can serve this product, ids from get_booking_resources

name: hub_set_product_booking_setup
title: Make a product bookable
